blurb: In today's digest: Etherfuse has been admitted by the National Bank of Kazakhst, Trump Media transfers 2,628 BTC worth $165M to Crypto.com as, and Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams
title: Crypto Trading Signals - August 02, 2026
top_story_headline: Etherfuse has been admitted by the National Bank of Kazakhstan to issue its core products the Stablebond for Kazakhstan.
top_story_comment: Etherfuse cleared one gate, not the whole stack: Kazakhstan registers DFA platforms with the National Bank, but assigns turnover of non-stablecoin DFAs to the financial-market regulator (https://nationalbank.kz/en/news/informacionnye-soobshcheniya/19193). Since Stablebonds tokenize sovereign debt rather than payment stablecoins, KZT DeFi liquidity lands inside that two-regulator perimeter created on May 1, 2026.
